constraints: Only enumerated read-only public RPC supplies block-hash-pinned state.

An inherent-only upgrade block is finalized with timestamp only; signed fixtures start in the next AllExtrinsics block. InvalidTransaction raw diffs are recorded and rolled back as in the node block builder.
Main branches replace only :code locally. Explicit --synthetic-fixtures branches additionally record every fixture key/value override; these do not claim mainnet-state coverage.

Synthetic headers and outer signed extrinsics use the mocked-signature marker. Inner validator heartbeats and migration ownership proofs use real signatures and Wasm verification; consensus validity and governance enactment are outside this rehearsal.
Independent fee cases branch from initialized local state; replay checks retain prior local execution. No transactions are submitted to the public network.
Migration ownership proofs use deterministic synthetic ed25519/SHA3 keys and real Wasm verification; only transaction/header signatures use the mocked host.

limitations: Synthetic validators, exposure pages and VAL budgets exercise candidate Wasm; they do not describe live validator rewards.

Ordinary-fee comparisons apply the candidate transaction-payment weight/length conversion and the pinned fee multipliers to the same observed weights. They are counterfactual prices, not a replay under another deployed runtime.
Each case has isolated synthetic block accounting; the fixture does not claim all cases fit in one block.
Transaction signatures use the mock host. Native tests cover real signatures and nonzero tips.
